findings.section: 1. Blunders: how often, and how much of the damage they are
findings.claim: In bullet the player blunders at about the same rate per 100 moves as the opponents in the same games.
findings.metric: moves with cp_loss >= 300 per 100 moves of the side, player minus opponents
findings.caveat: A blunder is cp_loss >= 300 on evals clipped at +-1000, so errors in already-decided positions are under-counted.
